about: The site config checks of the HTML adapter (siteValues() in adapters/html/generate.mjs): every case is an invalid site config and the message it fails with. adapters/html/test/html.test.ts runs each one through the generator, adapters/wordpress/test/SiteTest.php through the WordPress plugin's port of the checks — a new check with its case here fails the plugin's tests until it is ported. A case is `input`, the whole site config, or example/site.json with `site` merged over its top level and `language` ([lang, values]) over one language; a null value is the key left out. The plugin names a language's keys without `languages.<lang>.`; `wordpress` is its message where it has no such setting yet.

cases.name: a misspelt key
